==Description==
The '''Frostmite''', internally referred to as '''Elite Snowman''' is an enemy that appears in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. It is a quick enemy with a decent amount of health and [[Defense]].

Three '''Frostmites''' are spawned by the [[Frostbane]] on its death.

==Appearance==
The '''Frostmite''' is a creature made out of snow. It has a white torso, head and arms, alongside blue legs. On its torso, it has a neon blue light. Multiple spikes come out of its body. It has three different walking animations it can use.

==Strategy==
*Decent early-game towers, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Cowboy]] can be used to handle this rather easily.
**Due to it commonly spawning in hordes, towers like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be used to clear out multiple of them at once.
*While quite fast, it has no immunities, meaning any stalling tower can be used against it.

==Trivia==
*This enemy was originally made for the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], though it went unused until the release of the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode.
*It is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]].
